calendarCard.title: Upcoming drops for scans
calendarCard.body: Edit your content calendar on its own page so churn scans can reference what you actually plan to post.

autoScans.title: Automatic scans
autoScans.description: Matches your churn rules against OnlyFans & Fansly CRM fans. Charges up to {credits} {creditsLabel} only when the batch finds qualifiers—same cap as Scan now. Scheduled runs respect {fansPerRun} below; Scan now can review broader lists.
autoScans.lowCreditsTail: · or lower Credits per match in Configuration.
autoScans.recurrenceHint: Off defers to manual Scan only.
autoScans.weeklyFootnote: Weekly waits at least seven days since the previous run before the next window. Persist options with Save under Configuration.

config.title: Schedule & rules
config.description: Qualification, notifications, and follow-ups. Cadence is set in Automatic scans above; manual Scan now ignores it.
config.whoSub: OnlyFans and Fansly fans in your CRM. Narrow windows mean fewer, sharper names.
config.renewalHint: Days until subscription end to include.
config.quietHint: Days since last message to treat as quiet.
config.includeQuietLabel: Include quiet fans, not only renewals
config.includeQuietHelp: When off, only subscribers nearing expiry are considered.
config.batchSub: Credits when someone matches apply to every path. Scheduled runs use {fansPerRun}; Scan now analyzes all synced CRM (OnlyFans + Fansly together, up to 25 qualifiers).
config.fansPerRunHint: Automatic scans: max per report (1–25). Scan now considers both platforms together, up to 25 qualifiers.
config.creditsPerMatchHint: Up to this many after a successful run (1–10).
